https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The outer height of the vehicle. Note that you can use gr:hasMinValueFloat and gr:hasMaxValueFloat to indicate ranges. Typical unit code(s): CMT for centimeters, MTR for meters, INH for inches, FOT for foot/feet

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: height open tailgate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The outer height of the vehicle with the tailgate open. Note that you can use gr:hasMinValueFloat and gr:hasMaxValueFloat to indicate ranges. Typical unit code(s): CMT for centimeters, MTR for meters, INH for inches, FOT for foot/feet

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: includes
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: Links a Choice or Component to one or multiple other Choices Or Components implicity contained Note: This property is transitive, i.e., if B is included in A and C and D are included in B, then C and D are also included in A.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: includes choices
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: Indicates the set of Choices Or Components to which the Configuration Info node refers Note 1: Complementing compatibility information can be attached to the components directly via coo:compatibleWith, coo:incompatibleWith, coo:dependsOn, and coo:includes. Note 2: The coo:ConfigurationInfo node makes only a valid statement for a configuration that includes ALL of the Choices or Components attached via this property. Note 3: If you want to know whether further components can be added, check that there are no coo:incompatibleWith relationships with any Choice or Component. This check must also be extended to all Choices or Components implicitly included via coo:includes. Note 4: If you want to know whether some components may be omitted without invalidating the configuration, check that there are no coo:dependsOn relationships with any Choice or Component. This check must also be extended to all Choices Or Components implicitly included via coo:includes. Note 5: Under an Open World Assumption (OWA), only an explicit compatibility statement for your configuration is really reliable. A weaker guarantee may be sufficient for your application, though.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: incompatible with
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: Indicates that two Choices or Components are incompatible with each other, independent from other choices. Note: This property is symmetric, i.e., if A is incompatible with B, then B is also incompatible with A.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: inspected
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: This property points to inspections and certifications that the vehicle has undergone.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: length
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The outer length of the vehicle. Note that you can use gr:hasMinValueFloat and gr:hasMaxValueFloat to indicate ranges. Typical unit code(s): CMT for centimeters, MTR for meters, INH for inches, FOT for foot/feet

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: list price
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The original list price of the new car at the time of production

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: luggage capacity seats folded
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The available volume for cargo or luggage with the seats folded Typical unit code(s): LTR for liters, FTQ for cubic foot/feet Note: You can use gr:hasMinValueFloat and gr:hasMaxValueFloat to indicate ranges.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: luggage capacity seats upright
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The available volume for cargo or luggage with the seats upright Typical unit code(s): LTR for liters, FTQ for cubic foot/feet Note: You can use gr:hasMinValueFloat and gr:hasMaxValueFloat to indicate ranges.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: main location
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The main location(s) of the vehicle during the period of ownership

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: meets emission standard
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: Indicates that the vehicle meets the respective emission standard.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: mileage
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The mileage of the vehicle at the event, e.g. at the accident, maintenance, check, or modification. Typical unit code(s): KMT for kilometers, SMI for statute miles

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: mileage end
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The mileage of the vehicle at the end of the period of ownership. Typical unit code(s): KMT for kilometers, SMI for statute miles

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: mileage from odometer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The total distance travelled by the particular vehicle since its initial production, as read from its odometer. Typical unit code(s): KMT for kilometers, SMI for statute miles

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: mileage initial
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The mileage of the vehicle at the beginning of the period of ownership. Typical unit code(s): KMT for kilometers, SMI for statute miles

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: monthly payment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: Indicates the monthly payment for the financing

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: number of axles
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The number of axles. Typical unit code(s): C62

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: number of forward gears
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The total number of forward gears available for the transmission system of the vehicle. Typical unit code(s): C62

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: otr retail price
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: Indicates the OTR retail price for the financing

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: owner
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: This property points to the owner of the vehicle for the respective period of time, as indicated by the uco:OwnershipInfo node.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: parking
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The main type(s) of parking that have been used for the vehicle during the period of ownership (if attached to uco:OwnershipInfo) or in general (if attached to the vso:Vehicle directly)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: payload
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition:
The permitted weight of passengers and cargo, EXCLUDING the weight of the empty vehicle.

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

  • Note 1: Many databases specify the permitted TOTAL weight instead, which is the sum of weight and payload
  • Note 2: You can indicate additional information in the name of the QuantitativeValue node.
  • Note 3: You may also link to a QualitativeValue node that provides additional information using valueReference.
  • Note 4: Note that you can use minValue and maxValue to indicate ranges.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: pets
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The type(s) of animals that have been transported in the vehicle during the period of ownership (if attached to uco:OwnershipInfo) or in general (if attached to the vso:Vehicle directly). If possible, use DBPedia URIs, e.g. http://dbpedia.org/resource/Dog.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: price modiﬁer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: Links a coo:ConfigurationInfo node to information on a choice or component or the combination of multiple choices will affect the regular pricing of the resulting vehicle Note: The use of gr:addOn is in general a better way of modeling surcharges

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: reference distance
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The distance to which a vso:fuelConsumption value refers

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: reference fuel quantity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The quantity of fuel to which a vso:fuelEconomy value refers

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: reference speeds
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The interval of initial and target speed to which a vso:acceleration value refers

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: refers to traffic pattern
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: Indicates the traffic pattern to which the vso:fuelEconomy or vso:fuelConsumption value refers

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: roof load
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition:
The permitted total weight of cargo and installations (e.g. a roof rack) on top of the vehicle.

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

  • Note 1: You can indicate additional information in the name of the QuantitativeValue node.
  • Note 2: You may also link to a QualitativeValue node that provides additional information using valueReference
  • Note 3: Note that you can use minValue and maxValue to indicate ranges.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: rotational speed reference
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The rotational speed to which a vvo:torque or vso:enginePower value refers Typical unit code(s): RPM for revolutions per minute or RPS for revolutions per second

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: scrappage contribution
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: Indicates the scrappage contribution for the financing

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: seating capacity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The number of passengers that can be seated in the vehicle, both in terms of the physical space available, and in terms of limitations set by law. Typical unit code(s): C62 for persons.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: speed
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition:
The speed range of the vehicle. If the vehicle is powered by an engine, the upper limit of the speed range (indicated by maxValue should be the maximum speed achievable under regular conditions.

Typical unit code(s): KMH for km/h, HM for mile per hour (0.447 04 m/s), KNT for knot

*Note 1: Use minValue and maxValue to indicate the range. Typically, the minimal value is zero. * Note 2: There are many different ways of measuring the speed range. You can link to information about how the given value has been determined using the valueReference property.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: steering position
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The position of the steering wheel or similar device (mostly for cars)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: torque
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The torque (turning force) of an engine Typical unit code(s): NU for newton metre (N m), F17 for pound-force per foot, or F48 for pound-force per inch

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: total payable
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: Indicates the total payable for the financing

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: trailer weight
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition:
The permitted vertical load (TWR) of a trailer attached to the vehicle. Also referred to as Tongue Load Rating (TLR) or Vertical Load Rating (VLR)

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

  • Note 1: You can indicate additional information in the name of the QuantitativeValue node.
  • Note 2: You may also link to a QualitativeValue node that provides additional information using valueReference.
  • Note 3: Note that you can use minValue and maxValue to indicate ranges.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: transmission
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The type of component used for transmitting the power from a rotating power source to the wheels or propeller(s) ("gearbox" for cars). Use DBPedia resources to indicate the transmission type, if possible. Popular identifiers are http://dbpedia.org/resource/Manual_transmission http://dbpedia.org/resource/Automatic_transmission If you cannot find a suitable identifier in DBPedia, define your own as an instance of vso:TransmissionTypeValue.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: usage
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The type(s) of usage during the period of ownership (if attached to uco:OwnershipInfo) or in general (if attached to the vso:Vehicle directly)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: valuation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The market price assessment gained by the respective valuation. Use gr:name to indicate the name of the valuation service.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: vehicle engine
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: Information about the engine or engines of the vehicle.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: vehicle special usage
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: Indicates whether the vehicle has been used for special purposes, like commercial rental, driving school, or as a taxi. The legislation in many countries requires this information to be revealed when offering a car for sale.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: vehicle transmission
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The type of component used for transmitting the power from a rotating power source to the wheels or other relevant component(s) ("gearbox" for cars).

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: weight total
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition:
The permitted total weight of the loaded vehicle, including passengers and cargo and the weight of the empty vehicle.

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

  • Note 1: You can indicate additional information in the name of the QuantitativeValue node.
  • Note 2: You may also link to a QualitativeValue node that provides additional information using valueReference.
  • Note 3: Note that you can use minValue and maxValue to indicate ranges.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: wheelbase
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition:
The distance between the centers of the front and rear wheels.

Typical unit code(s): CMT for centimeters, MTR for meters, INH for inches, FOT for foot/feet

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: width
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The outer width of the vehicle. Note that you can use gr:hasMinValueFloat and gr:hasMaxValueFloat to indicate ranges. Typical unit code(s): CMT for centimeters, MTR for meters, INH for inches, FOT for foot/feet

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: width excluding door mirrors
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The outer width of the vehicle, excluding door mirrors. Note that you can use gr:hasMinValueFloat and gr:hasMaxValueFloat to indicate ranges. Typical unit code(s): CMT for centimeters, MTR for meters, INH for inches, FOT for foot/feet

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: width with doors open
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The outer width of the vehicle with the doors open. Note that you can use gr:hasMinValueFloat and gr:hasMaxValueFloat to indicate ranges. Typical unit code(s): CMT for centimeters, MTR for meters, INH for inches, FOT for foot/feet

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: used in
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates a vehicle part to an operation in which it is used

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: has signal
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: Property of having signals in a branch

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: node position
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates a node to its position expressed in longitude, latitude and optionally altitude

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: path segment ID
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates a path segment to its ID

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates an infrastructure to its address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: admin area
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates a node, an infrastructure or a natural place to its administrative area

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: allow lane change
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: indicates whether a vehicle can change lanes

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: altitude
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates a vehicle or a node to its altitude expressed in meters

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: bound position
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates a junction or a road segment with its boundary GPS point

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: brand
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates a material entity to its brand

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: driving direction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates a lane to its driving direction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: is empty
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: indicates whether a given road part is empty

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: latitude
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates a vehicle or a node to its latitude

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: location x
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates a node to its x coordinate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: location y
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates a node to its y coordinate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: location z
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates a node to its z coordinate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: longitude
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates a vehicle or a node to its longitude

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates something to its name

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: opening hours
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates an infrastructure or a natural place to the hours during which it is open

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: OSM node ID
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates a node to its OpenStreetMap ID

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: OSM refrence
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: links a road individual to OpenStreetMap map entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: OSM way ID
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates a way to its OpenStreetMap ID

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: phone
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates an infrastructure to its phone number

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: postcode
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates an infrastructure to its postal code

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: river ID
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates a river to its ID

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: speed max
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates a lane to the maximum speed a vehicle can legally drive at while on it

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: website
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates an infrastructure or a natural place to its website

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: movement speed
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates a vehicle to its movement speed

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: object mass
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates an object to its mass

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: object value
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates an object to its value

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: gross combination weight rating
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The value specified by the manufacturer as the recommended maximum loaded weight of a combination (articulated) motor vehicle.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: gross vehicle weight
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The actual weight of a road vehicle including the weight of the road vehicle, its load of persons and property, and all added equipment.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: gross vehicle weight rating
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The value specified by the manufacturer as the recommended maximum loaded weight of a single motor vehicle.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: total lanes in roadway
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: A number of through lanes of the roadway.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: has max value
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: QName: auto-mo-mo:hasMaxValue

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: has min value
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: QName: auto-mo-mo:hasMinValue

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: has unit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: QName: auto-mo-mo:hasUnit

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: has value
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: QName: auto-mo-mo:hasValue

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: acriss code
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The ACRISS Car Classification Code is a code used by many car rental companies, for classifying vehicles. ACRISS stands for Association of Car Rental Industry Systems and Standards.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: airbag deployment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: This property indicates whether at least one of the airbags of the vehicle has been deployed in the respective accident (when attached to uco:DamageOrAccident) or ever (when directly applied to a vso:Vehicle).

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: apr
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: Annual percentage rate. Note: 7.5 % is encoded as "7.5"^^xsd:decimal, not "0.075"^^xsd:decimal.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: cap code
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The CAP code

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: color
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The color of the vehicle

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: condition
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: A textual description of the condition of the vehicle. This property should be mainly used with gr:ActualProductOrServiceInstance.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: country of origin
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The country or geo-political region in which the vehicle was initially sold officially, indicated as the two-character version of ISO 3166-1 (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) for regions or ISO 3166-2, which breaks down the countries from ISO 3166-1 into administrative subdivisions.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: country of registration
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The country or geo-political region in which the vehicle is currently registered, indicated as the two-character version of ISO 3166-1 (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) for regions or ISO 3166-2, which breaks down the countries from ISO 3166-1 into administrative subdivisions.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: cylinder type id
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The Volkswagen-specific identifier for the cylinder type of a vehicle or engine

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: date launched
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The date of the official launch of the car model

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: date vehicle first registered
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The date of the first registration of the vehicle with the respective public authorities.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: dh code
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The DH code

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: display position
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The position at which the option or element should be listed in a menu or user dialog, lower numbers come first. The main usage of this property are coo:SpecItemCollection and coo:ChoiceOrComponent, but it is possible to apply it to any owl:Class. Note: It is recommended to rely on this property only for data originating from a single RDF graph; otherwise, unpredictable results are possible.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: emissions CO2
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The CO2 emissions in g/km. When used in combination with a QuantitativeValue, put "g/km" into the unitText property of that value, since there is no UN/CEFACT Common Code for "g/km".

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: emissions per passenger
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: relates a vehicle to the amount of emissions it emits per passenger present in it during driving

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: engine name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: A short text indicating the engine(s) of the vehicle

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: final payment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: Indicates the final payment for the financing

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: from
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: This property indicates the beginning of the period of ownership represented by this uco:OwnershipInfo node.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: fuel injection type id
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The Volkswagen-specific identifier for the fuel injection type of a vehicle or engine

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: gearbox type id
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The Volkswagen-specific gearbox type ID

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: has electric energy consumtion
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: This property represents the electric energy consumption of a vehicle measured in Wh/km.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: has emissions reduction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: This property represents emissions reduction measured in g/km that a vehicle has, through the implemented innovative technologies.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: has engine capacity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: This property shows the capacity of the engine of a vehicle measured in cm3

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: has fuel mode
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: This property represents the fuel mode of a vehicle

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: has ID
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: An annotation property that can be used to attach element identifiers from XML schemas for the corresponding XML data or schema

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: has innovative technology
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: This property represents an innovation technology that a vehicle has implemented.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: has MSReg manufacturer name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: This property represents a manufacturer name as in the registry of Member States of the European Environment Agency.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: has manufacturer harmonised name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: This property represents a manufacturer harmonised name.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: has manufacturer pooling
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: This property represents a manufacturers pooling.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: has other axle width
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: This property represents the width of the other steering axle of a vehicle measured in mm.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: has steering axle width
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: This property represents the width of the steering axle of a vehicle measured in mm.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: has total new registrations
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: This property represents the nubmer of total new registration of a vehicle.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: has type approval number
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: This property represents an internal type approval number.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: indication of odometer rollback
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: This property indicates whether it is likely or known that the odometer of the vehicle does not properly reflect the total mileage of the vehicle, e.g. because the odometer has been replaced, reset, or tampered with

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: insurance group
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The insurance group code

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: insurance group 50
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The insurance group 50 code

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: known vehicle damages
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: A textual description of known damages, both repaired and unrepaired.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: license plate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The license plate string(s) assigned to the vehicle during the period of ownership

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: manufacturer code
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The manufacturer code

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: marketing name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The name of the object for marketing purposes

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: max
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The maximum number of coo:ChoiceOrComponent entities that can be selected for a valid configuration

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: min
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.definition: The minimum number of coo:ChoiceOrComponent entities that must be selected for a valid configuration

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/auto/ontolog.label: number of monthly payments
